rod.motion: constant-speed reflected motion; body pose updated each capture

raised_start.method: the one warmed, wrist-constrained loop planner solves from the camera-front seed to world +0.20 m Z with the same tool orientation; the solved state is used directly as loop start and that solve is not executed as experiment motion

observation_rule: exact n/30 sim-time poses; consume latest frame at control ticks; hold fit/velocity between frames
prediction_rule: single velocity sweep over full MPC horizon plus 1/30 s; no old factor of two
plant: held joint velocity; command delta bounded by config acceleration times 25 ms; ideal discrete plant
case_order: speed, phase, repeat 1..5, A/B/E; fresh MPC instance each run

wrist_3_limit.method: load existing YAML into cuRobo RobotCfg, modify the in-memory JointLimits.position tensor before MotionPlannerCfg.create; IK, TrajOpt, and PRM receive the same RobotCfg

loaded_config.acceleration_source: robot YAML kinematics.cspace.max_acceleration, scaled by acceleration_scale; same robot config supplied to MPC

storage.trace: exact control-boundary states; dense collision scoring unchanged; linear held-velocity interpolation
storage.fit: center, dimensions, point count; repeated renderer metadata omitted
